# pg-corpus.txt - Wave 6a vertex corpus.
# ORDER IS PART OF THE FIXTURE: pre-state 3 means CARRY, and the
# SHARED / CARRY classes depend on the preceding case's page.
# pre: 0 blank, 1 (i*101)&255, 2 sentinel every 997th, 3 carry
# tex: 0 (i*37+11)&255, 1 (i>>8)^(i&255), 2 all-ones, 3 wrap probes
